title: CORE-7108 · SITEWIDE body base font — VERIFIED, true in source, zero visible impact
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-7108](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7108)

**Report:** `reports/T35-CORE-7108-verification.md`

**Premise true at the `<body>` level, but no rendered text is affected. Not a rendering defect. No PR.**

| | live | clone |
|---|---|---|
| `<body>` font-family | `myriad-pro-semi-condensed, verdana-fallback, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif` | `Inter, "Inter Fallback"` |
| `<body>` size / line-height | **18px / 27px** | **16px / 24px** |

## But nothing inherits it

Every visible text-bearing element outside header/footer/nav, grouped by resolved family:

| page | width | elements | chars | Myriad | Inter |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| live `/` | 1440 | 261 | 18,582 | **100%** | 0 |
| clone `/` | 1440 | 262 | 19,045 | **100%** | 0 |
| live `/` | 360 | 260 | 18,572 | **100%** | 0 |
| clone `/` | 360 | 261 | 19,035 | **100%** | 0 |
| clone `/privacy-policy` | 1440 | 326 | 32,151 | **100%** | 0 |
| clone `/id-requirements` | 1440 | 27 | 2,717 | **100%** | 0 |
| clone `/site-map` | 1440 | 85 | 1,477 | **100%** | 0 |
| clone `/a-z-glossary-of-terms` | 1440 | 176 | 17,818 | **100%** | 0 |

Rich-text-heavy pages chosen deliberately as the likeliest place for a missed opt-in. There is none.
Size distributions match, and the two shared homepage headings are identical on both sites
(`36px/44.46px w400` at 1440 and 360).

Face resolution proved by canvas fingerprinting against 11 candidate families: live `<body>` renders
468.79px for a fixed sample and `myriad-pro-semi-condensed` measures **468.79px exactly**; every other
candidate is 22-214px away.

## Not a licensing matter

Myriad is already licensed and wired: `layout.tsx` injects the Adobe Typekit kit gated on
`NEXT_PUBLIC_ADOBE_FONT_PROJECT_ID` (`wrj3hpa` in `.env`). The local build emits the Typekit `<link>`.
Applied opt-in per element via `.font-legacy-condensed` (`globals.css:626-630`), 76 occurrences across
74 files.

## The real risk, already documented

`.claude/QCF_GOTCHAS.md` records an actual incident on this exact variable: absent in Vercel, so the
`{adobeFontProjectId && (...)}` branch never emitted the Typekit `<link>` and **the whole deployed site
fell back to Inter with a green build**. `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` is inlined at build time, so adding the variable
requires a **redeploy**. That is a deployment-config concern, not a code defect.

**Action worth more than any code change:** confirm the deployed HTML still contains the Typekit link.
`curl -s <deployed-url>/ | grep -c typekit` — 0 means the variable never reached the build. I could not
run it: the Vercel URL sits behind the SSO wall and answers HTTP 200 with a login page.

## Why the base declaration was NOT changed

Adding the Myriad stack to `body` would be provably zero-visual-change today, but fixes nothing real:
it does not mitigate the env-var hazard (if Typekit fails, Myriad is unavailable wherever declared), and
it would only change what the site falls back **to** — and Encode Sans is a *closer* metric match to
Myriad Semi Condensed than live's Verdana chain, so copying live would arguably make degraded rendering
worse. A sitewide base-typography declaration is the highest-blast-radius change in this repo; not worth
it on agent judgement.

## Also logged

At 360 the shared homepage `<h2>` box is **305px on live vs 320px on the clone** — 15px container-width
difference with identical font metrics. Horizontal gutters, not typography.
acceptanceCriteria: Ticket closed or re-scoped — no rendered text is Inter on either site.
Deployment check raised: assert the Typekit <link> is present in the deployed HTML (ideally in CI).
If a base font-family declaration is still wanted, it is reviewed as a typography decision, not a bug fix.
360 container-width difference (305 vs 320) routed to whichever ticket owns mobile gutters.
